x: I literally started the vlog and I was like, "hey!".
I think maybe in this video, this vlog, I'm just in the mood to talk, you know, I don't really have much to show.

s.d: A weblog using video as its primary presentation format.
x: When you create this kind of videoless vlog, where you don't have the video recorded on a camcorder, you have to be more conscious of the story you want to tell.
So we are going to do a week of me vlogging.

s.d: To contribute to a video weblog.
x: I like to take walks when I'm having my breaks at work, and then I vlog my walks and put them online. I can just ramble on about philosophy, or whatever.

s.d: To post (something) to a video weblog.
